verdicts.why: The model names the same 1000-litre caged IBC water tank shown in the photos.
An industrial engine is a broader but non-contradictory description of the Detroit Diesel marine engine.
A steering rack is a different part from the oil pump and balance shaft assembly.
The photos show a Nissan Diesel borehole drilling machine, not an Isuzu truck-mounted crane.
The model identifies a controller rather than the PS4 Pro console, though controllers are included in the bundle.
A white sofa is the same kind of two-seater sofa shown in the photos.
A motor scooter is consistent with the gray electric scooter shown in the photos.
A stack of second-hand books is consistent with the business and self-help books shown.
An automatic transmission is the same item as the Mercedes automatic transmission gearbox.
An insulated bag is a non-contradictory description of the fabric lunch bag.
Pulleys on a stand are a different item from the industrial gas cooker.
A stack of books is consistent with the bundle of six sales and marketing books.
The model correctly identifies the PS4 game console bundle, with the Star Wars edition shown in the photos.
An alternator is a different item from the worm gear speed reducer gearbox.
The Nikon D3100 is a different model from the advertised and pictured Nikon D610.
